public_payload.normalized_proposition: CoreWeave lacks the liquidity to expand as required, and further loans depend on contracts that themselves depend on that expansion.

statement.excerpt: It currently lacks the liquidity to do so, and further loans will be contingent on its contracts, which are contingent on CoreWeave's ability to aggressively expand.
statement.document_title: The Phony Comforts of AI Optimism

from_speaker: further loans will be contingent on its contracts
contracts, which are contingent on CoreWeave's ability to aggressively expand
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that existing available funding cannot cover the expansion needed to serve the OpenAI agreement without additional financing.
Liquidity includes unrestricted cash and available committed borrowing facilities, subject to draw conditions. Restricted cash is not automatically available.

Use fiscal 2024, the latest completed reporting period publicly reportable before the post, for the liquidity benchmark. Subsequent contract announcements provide context but cannot establish that year-end funding position.
The surrounding discussion relies on press-reported liquidity and spending estimates. It does not specify a GAAP liquidity measure.
Contract-backed borrowing need not mean expansion must be completed before lenders can advance construction funding.
criteria.support_condition: A dated funding schedule shows that available liquidity falls short of the required expansion spending, and applicable lending and customer agreements establish both claimed dependencies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show sufficient available funding for the required expansion, or show that the relevant borrowing or customer obligations do not have the claimed dependencies.
